- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] The plan includes various activities and resources for Betsy to use to achieve these goals.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Another activity is to participate in ongoing professional development on differentiation strategies for struggling students.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The timeline for this professional development plan will span the course of one school year.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The mentor teacher will provide support throughout the year as well.
